scope: Exact unchanged Debian Chromium ARM64, headless/software Wayland, 100 percent scale; ordinary wrapped native textareas

implementation.provider: Ordinary NSTextView/NSScrollView; native clip frame, scroller-free client size and constrained min/max points. No new control implementation, layout, range-clamping or key table.
implementation.transport: Optional append-only API and owner-connection-only operation 34 payload; earlier by-value viewport and operations 32/33 unchanged.
implementation.engine: Exact textarea/owning layout identity. Native geometry feeds PaintLayerScrollableArea and PhysicalContractedBoxRect; original DOM rounding/zoom conversion remains in Blink. Native offsets use real SetScrollOffset/UpdateScrollOffset, retaining trusted scroll events. Native-to-engine offset transfer runs on the renderer work path, outside painting.
implementation.paint: Only the border-box theme call paints the complete native control. Guarded PaintInfo contents-background flag avoids a second document-sized native widget; native scroll updates invalidate the border-box display item.
implementation.pointer: Native NSScrollView supplies its own scroller and tracking. Blink scrollbar creation and overlapping corner resize grip/hit testing are disabled only for native-owned textareas. CSS/script enclosing-box resizing remains available. No replacement grip or scroller code.
implementation.feature: NEXTSPACE_CHROMIUM_MULTILINE_VIEWPORT=1 in addition to existing FORMS/INPUT/TEXT/MULTILINE flags, provider capabilities VIEWPORT and GEOMETRY, exact build-ID/instruction guards. Not the installed desktop default.

input_scope: Viewport pointer checks use CDP mouse events. Existing 18-per-browser multiline editing checks use actual compositor-seat keyboard input. No wheel or physical-pointer parity claim.
native_pixel_scope: Twelve complete browser/provider RGB image comparisons, across host replacement: top, middle, end, resized, wrapped and short/autohidden native scrollbar. Provider suite independently retains complete direct-AppKit reference comparisons.
binary_boundary: Only provider/loader/shim, small probes and preload adapter compiled. Browser executables/libxul and installed AppKit unchanged. No browser rebuild.

retained_failures.second_background: Initial screenshot omitted the native bar because Blink themed both border-box and scrolling-content background. Bounded native bitmap trace exposed the document-sized second pass. Speculative anonymous-layer suppression did not solve it and was removed.
retained_failures.client_geometry: Initial engine clientHeight 124 differed from native clip height 122; exact padding-box boundary now supplies native measurements while retaining DOM conversion.
retained_failures.resize_grip: Browser corner resize hit testing consumed the native arrow click. Disable browser grip only on native-owned textarea; native click/repeat/release then passes.
retained_failures.stale_pixels: First exact middle-scroll image check failed despite correct DOM offset 73 and trusted event: border-box bitmap still showed line zero. Native offset updates now invalidate that image. The final check-03 passes all 34 rows after the renderer-work-path review fix.

cleanup.owned_process_scan: No live viewport browser/suite, gdb or strace fixture processes after teardown; CDP automation disconnected, forward 9952 to 9248 cancelled.

remaining: Route native wheel input/policy to the real native scroll view; current checks cover programmatic offsets and native arrow tracking, not wheel parity.

Finish other browser frontend controls, dialogs, menus and rich text; audited automatic build selection/installation and actual installed Workspace/PAM deployment.
Qualify Chrome, Vivaldi, Firefox derivatives and other browser versions/architectures, then continue remaining non-GNUstep GTK/Qt/KDE applications.
